notes: INSIDE half of the Grundl Grapple Harpoon: a big chain winch drum that winds more chain as it charges (frame 5 = wound and ready, lamps green), a geared motor, hatch with rivets, power coupling and five amber lamps. fire: the drum is empty and spinning. damaged: the chain has slipped and hangs loose, lamps dead; disabled: the drum jammed, the chain snapped. Barrel layer grundl_grapple_harpoon_barrel: a long banded launch tube with a barbed harpoon head loaded and its chain running back; fire: the harpoon leaves on its chain.
